## README.md
# USGS Datasets (`public-usgs`)

Cloud-native mirrors of U.S. Geological Survey datasets (GeoParquet, PMTiles, H3 hex).

## USGS Mineral Resources Data System (MRDS) — US mineral deposits

Point locations of metallic, non-metallic, and energy mineral deposits, occurrences,
mines, and processing plants across the United States (CONUS, Alaska, Hawaii, and US
territories): **266,593 points**, native H3 resolution **10**.

Built from the full MRDS tabular CSV release (MRDS no longer ships Shapefile/GDB/KML),
restricted to `country = 'United States'` with valid coordinates, and reduced to a
curated attribute set. Each point maps to exactly one H3 cell (parents 9, 8, 0);
`_cng_fid` is the universal per-feature id.

> **Vintage:** MRDS was last systematically maintained ~2011 and is no longer actively
> updated — treat it as a historical compilation. Per-record quality varies; see the
> `score` column (USGS/Schweitzer 2019 grade, A best → E least complete). USGS **USMIN**
> is a fresher companion for selected commodities.

**License:** public domain (U.S. Government work).

### Assets

| Asset key | Format | Path |
|---|---|---|
| `mrds-parquet` | GeoParquet | `mrds.parquet` |
| `mrds-pmtiles` | PMTiles | `mrds.pmtiles` |
| `mrds-hex` | H3 hex Parquet | `mrds/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` |

### MapLibre GL JS

The PMTiles **`source-layer` is `mrds`** (not the source file name).

```js
import { Protocol } from "pmtiles";
const protocol = new Protocol();
maplibregl.addProtocol("pmtiles", protocol.tile);

map.addSource("mrds", {
  type: "vector",
  url: "pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs/mrds.pmtiles"
});

map.addLayer({
  id: "mrds-points",
  type: "circle",
  source: "mrds",
  "source-layer": "mrds",           // <-- last segment of the dataset name
  paint: {
    "circle-radius": 3,
    "circle-color": [
      "match", ["get", "com_type"],
      "M", "#d7301f",                // metallic
      "N", "#2b8cbe",                // non-metallic
      "B", "#756bb1",                // both
      "E", "#31a354",                // energy
      "#999999"                      // other / null
    ],
    "circle-opacity": 0.8
  }
});
```

### DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;

-- Flat GeoParquet: all sites with attributes + geometry
SELECT site_name, state, commod1, dev_stat, ST_AsText(geom) AS geom
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs/mrds.parquet')
WHERE state = 'Colorado' AND com_type = 'M'
LIMIT 10;

-- Count sites (points map 1:1 to cells, so _cng_fid is unique per hex row)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT _cng_fid) AS n_sites
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs/mrds/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet');

-- Hex join key: h8 is the catalog's universal join resolution
SELECT h8, COUNT(*) AS n_sites
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs/mrds/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet')
GROUP BY h8 ORDER BY n_sites DESC LIMIT 10;
```

### Column notes

- `_cng_fid` — universal per-feature id; join key between flat and hex, dedup key for `COUNT(DISTINCT)`.
- `com_type` — M=Metallic, N=Non-metallic, B=Both, E=Energy.
- `region` — NA=North America (CONUS+Alaska), CR=Caribbean (PR, USVI), OC=Oceania (Hawaii/Pacific).
- `prod_size` — S/M/L=Small/Medium/Large produced, Y/N=production occurred or not, U=Unknown.
- `dev_stat` — Occurrence, Prospect, Producer, Past Producer, Plant, Unknown.
- `score` — record-quality grade A (most complete) → E (least complete); not a correctness measure.

Full per-column definitions are in each asset's `table:columns` in
[`mrds/stac-collection.json`](https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs/mrds/stac-collection.json).

**Source:** USGS Mineral Resources Data System — <https://mrdata.usgs.gov/mrds/>

## USGS Undiscovered Oil and Gas Assessment Units — United States

USGS estimates of undiscovered, technically recoverable oil, gas and natural gas liquids for
the onshore and state-water United States, as Assessment Unit (AU) polygons with a probability
distribution (F95, F50, F5, mean) per unit: **240 assessment units**, native H3 resolution **8**.

USGS publishes the national assessment one province or formation release at a time and there is
no national compilation upstream, so this layer was merged from the **57 United States releases**
in the [National and Global Oil and Gas Assessment Project ScienceBase community](https://www.sciencebase.gov/catalog/item/59cab03de4b017cf314094df),
accessed **2026-09-21**. It carries **no version number**: the edition record is the release
manifest, and each row names its own release in `sciencebase_id` and `release_pubdate`.
Coverage is the releases in that community, not every assessed US province: the Paradox Basin
(province 5021) is the separate `paradox-basin-assessment-units` collection.

> **Three things to know before aggregating.** Assessment units **overlap** (conventional and
> continuous units and different Total Petroleum Systems cover the same ground), so a spatial
> join returns several units per location; on the hex asset, dedup by `ASSESSCODE` before any
> `SUM`. Only the **mean** is additive across units — `F95`, `F50` and
> `F5` are fractiles of one unit's distribution. And **null is never zero**: only 66 of the 240
> units carry volume estimates, because the remaining releases publish boundaries and assessment
> input forms without a results table.

```sql
-- total mean undiscovered gas: most units split it into AG_ and NAGAS_; a few report only GAS_
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(GAS_MN_BCF, COALESCE(AG_MN_BCF, 0) + COALESCE(NAGAS_MN_BCF, 0))) AS gas_bcf
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs/noga-assessment-units.parquet');
```

Full documentation:
[`noga-assessment-units/README.md`](https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs/noga-assessment-units/README.md)
and
[`noga-assessment-units/stac-collection.json`](https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs/noga-assessment-units/stac-collection.json).

**Source:** USGS assessments of undiscovered oil and gas —
<https://www.usgs.gov/centers/central-energy-resources-science-center/science/united-states-assessments-undiscovered-oil>

---

## USGS Paradox Basin Undiscovered Oil and Gas Assessment Units (2011)

The USGS 2011 assessment of undiscovered, technically recoverable oil, gas and natural gas
liquids in the Paradox Basin Province (5021; Utah, Colorado, New Mexico, Arizona): **10
assessment units** with F95, F50, F5, mean and standard deviation volumes per unit, native H3
resolution **8**. Mean totals are 560 million barrels of oil, 12,699 billion cubic feet of gas and
491 million barrels of NGL, matching USGS Fact Sheet 2012-3031. Province 5021 is not part of the
national `noga-assessment-units` layer above.

> Units **overlap**, only the **mean** is additive across units, and the source stores **0**
> (never null) for quantities that do not apply to a unit's type and for the one unit that was not
> quantitatively assessed.

Full documentation:
[`paradox-basin-assessment-units/README.md`](https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs/paradox-basin-assessment-units/README.md)
and
[`paradox-basin-assessment-units/stac-collection.json`](https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs/paradox-basin-assessment-units/stac-collection.json).

**Source:** USGS Paradox Basin Oil and Gas Assessments —
<https://www.usgs.gov/centers/central-energy-resources-science-center/science/paradox-basin-oil-and-gas-assessments>
(data release <https://doi.org/10.5066/P9PAEXLB>, accessed 2026-09-24)
